items.title: Introducing change-based throttling for Amazon Route 53 APIs
items.summary: Amazon Route 53 now uses change-based throttling and has doubled its default API request rate from 5 to 10 requests per second. Learn how the new per-account model works, with separate request-rate and change-throughput limits, and best practices for automating DNS management at scale.
items.creator: Bhargav Talluri
